readerUiConversion.staticDefaultRule: When ReaderUiStore has no explicit typography or page-space preference, sharedReaderSurface uses the live Figma default Noto Serif SC / 18px / 1.96 line-height / 15.8px paragraph gap / 2em indent and the Figma 72px/32px page space. An explicit ReaderUiStore value remains a behavior-owned override.
readerUiConversion.traceability: The rendered PaperLayer and ReadingContent carry their exact Phone/Tablet Figma node IDs. This is trace metadata only; it does not make DOM attributes a visual authority.
excluded: Reader control home, quick modules, full modules, TTS, directory, settings, and content search remain separate candidate-backport records whose retired routeIds are physically absent; they are pending independent source conversion and are not active quarantine entries.
No Figma node, component, reaction, token, or asset was written or recreated.
No HarmonyOS renderer, admission state, emulator, device, Core, Host, or release-lock was changed in B2.

splitPerformed.summary: The 3 shared old reading-page overlay identities (ReaderDirectoryPanel/ReaderAppearancePanel/ReaderReplacePanel) were split into retained shared primitives (DirectoryPanel/AppearancePanel/ReplacePanel) and retired reading-surface identities (explicit-gap, 0 fixtures). Reader-UI now proves 19 historical source implementations globally unreachable. ReaderControlSheet remains directly reused by SourceSwitchFlowPage and ReaderAutoScrollPanel remains canonical for auto-page. The 2 HarmonyOS-only motion coordinators require the independent A2 consumer proof.
splitPerformed.sourceSideSplit: Reader-UI schema enum 177 (174 + 3 new shared-primitive types DirectoryPanel/AppearancePanel/ReplacePanel); 17 surviving route fixtures rebound to new types; 13 retired route fixtures 0 residue; old 3 types now explicit-gap mirroring ReaderTtsPanel/ReaderSettingsPanel.
splitPerformed.consumerSideSplit: Not claimed by B2. HarmonyOS reachability and dispatch cleanup require an independent clean A2 consumer-side commit after B3 and before B4 promotion.

pageAnimationContract.note: The source fixture and generated ArkTS/Kotlin/Swift contracts preserve 覆盖/滑动/仿真/滚动/无动画 in exact order. A three-option rewrite cannot pass this gate.

downstreamBoundary.rule: Machine receipt and release identity are B7 evidence, not B2 or B3 prerequisites.
